The West Bengal Central School Service Commission
ACHARYA SADAN: 11 & 11/1, Block-EE, Salt Lake; Kolkata-700091
NOTIFICATION
Memo. No.905 /6723(IV)/CSSC/ESTT/2023 Dated: 25.08.2023
It is hereby notified for all concerned that some categories of panels/waitlists required under the
system of multi-ranking were not reflected as uploaded vide memo no.890/6723(IV)/CSSC/ESTT/2023
dated 23.08.2023 due to a technical error. The same are now incorporated herewith and reflected in
concerned different categories of panel/waitlists now being uploaded.
It is further informed that neither the individual scores nor the relative ranks of the candidates have
been affected in the new list.
Sd/-
Secretary
West Bengal Central School Service Commission
